root_causes: Wrong object identity: the policy manipulated toy_vehicle_1 instead of the specified task object toy_vehicle_0, so one of the required objects was never correctly handled.

Incomplete goal satisfaction: only 2 of 4 propositions were completed by episode end, indicating that not all task constraints (both objects on table, next to each other, construction set untouched) were simultaneously satisfied.
Ineffective waiting behavior: Agent 0 remained in a Wait[None] action (steps 11–15) while still holding toy_vehicle_1, instead of placing it on the table to finalize the arrangement.
Coordination gap between agents: Agent 1 rearranged toy_animal_2 relative to toy_vehicle_1 while Agent 0 continued holding the vehicle, preventing a stable final configuration.
Insufficient final-state checking: the system ended the episode with only partial task completion and did not trigger additional replanning to resolve remaining unsatisfied propositions.
improvement_suggestions: Enforce strict object ID consistency so that the planner and executor always use the exact task-specified objects (toy_vehicle_0, toy_animal_2) and do not substitute similarly typed objects (e.g., toy_vehicle_1).
Add a final validation step before episode termination that checks all task propositions (location, relationships, and 'leave in place' constraints) and triggers replanning if any remain unsatisfied.

Refine multi-agent coordination such that when one agent is using an object as a spatial reference (next_to), the other agent first places that object in its final location rather than keeping it in hand.
Discourage or constrain prolonged Wait[None] actions while holding task objects; instead, bias the policy toward completing pending placements when an object is already grasped.
Introduce explicit handling for 'leave it where it is' constraints, verifying that non-target objects like the toy_construction_set remain on their original receptacles after other rearrangements.
overall_assessment: The agents made partial progress (2/4 propositions) but failed to correctly manipulate the specified toy vehicle and to finalize the required arrangement, leading to premature termination with the task half complete.
task_instruction: Help me tidy up the bedroom. Move the toy vehicle and toy animal from the chest of drawers to the table. Place them next to each other. Leave the toy construction set where it is.
